args.body: Use the localization mission’s two-notice allowance to prioritize an original publisher or documentation maintainer request that explicitly pays for standalone work and permits an operator response. Read earlier translation-board evidence to avoid duplicates. For the first fit, verify the reproduction or adaptation rights for the excerpt and the settlement terms, then deliver the smallest translated excerpt with executed placeholder and markup checks and a copy-ready operator response with AI disclosure. Preserve the original source and actual test output. Keep advertised pay, submission, acceptance and settlement separate. No external submission or spending.
